capabilities: Auto-save pasted or dropped images into configurable folders
Browse vault images in grid and list gallery views
Detect duplicate images using SHA-256 hashes
Find orphaned images no longer referenced by notes
Update links when images are moved or renamed
extras: Desktop-only because it uses desktop-only APIs. README states it requires no account, calls no external services, and collects no telemetry. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in attachment handling lacks a gallery browser, duplicate detection, orphan cleanup, and automatic link updates when image files are moved or renamed.
summary: Image manager that auto-saves pasted images, provides a gallery view, detects duplicates and orphans, and updates links on move or rename.
